V1.5.20.title: Instant dyslexia tint controls
features: Shows the tint colour and strength controls immediately when Dyslexia tint overlay is turned on.
Hides the tint controls immediately when the overlay is turned off.
Applies and removes the full-app glass tint instantly without refreshing the page.
Keeps the selected colour and strength saved on the learner’s device.

V1.5.19.title: Reliable update descriptions
features: Loads update descriptions from one central release-notes file instead of hard-coded service-worker text.
Automatically displays the notes that match the version being installed.
Keeps the notification centre and update installation popup in sync.
Includes a safe fallback message if release notes cannot be loaded while offline.

V1.5.18.title: Toolbox and Settings help tours
features: Updates the information tour for every Toolbox section.
Adds guided help for MeasureMate, MaterialMate, NoteMate, DrawingMate and ProjectMate.
Adds separate guidance for Settings: General, Notifications and Learning Support.
Highlights the current reading guide, text-to-speech and dyslexia tint controls.

V1.5.17.title: Tint colour picker
features: Adds a clearly labelled overlay-colour selector in Learning Support.
Provides Yellow, Blue, Mint, Peach, Rose and Grey tint choices.
Applies colour and strength changes instantly across the entire app.
Saves the selected tint settings on the learner's device.

V1.5.21.title: Search activity pill text fix
features: Restores the missing first letter on every Popular Course Activities search pill.
Corrects the activity-title cleaning rule so normal titles such as Health & Safety and Cavity Walling remain complete.
Keeps assignment-code removal working only when a genuine code separator is present.

V1.5.22.title: Complete Settings help highlights
features: Makes the green help-tour highlight cover the complete Settings tile or switch row instead of only the hidden checkbox control.
Adds visible highlights for every General, Notifications and Learning Support setting.
Shows the Dyslexia tint colour and strength controls inside the tour even when the tint is currently switched off.
Keeps the phone preview scrolling to each highlighted Settings item.

V1.5.23.title: Admin Mode moved to Settings
features: Moves Admin Mode to the final section in Settings.
Keeps Admin Mode protected by the existing four-digit password.
Automatically locks Admin Mode whenever its window is closed.
Removes the old Admin Mode link from the evidence-pack page.

V1.5.24.title: Full-app colour themes
features: App colour now changes buttons, tabs, selected states and progress highlights throughout Apprentice+.
Built-in line icons and icon backgrounds now follow the selected app colour.
Completion cards, active navigation, switches, focus rings and accent borders update immediately.
Warning, error and evidence-type colours remain distinct for clarity.

V1.5.25.title: Reliable Course navigation
features: Keeps the Course button responsive without requiring a page refresh.
Moves primary navigation handling to capture-phase touch and click listeners so child controls cannot consume the tap.
Keeps the bottom navigation above non-modal accessibility overlays and repairs stale pointer-event states after resume.
Replaces the timing-only tap guard with a render-safe navigation lock.

V1.5.26.title: Clear Text-to-Speech speaker icon
features: Displays the speaker symbol in solid white inside every Text-to-Speech button.
Prevents the selected app colour from overriding the speaker glyph.
Slightly enlarges and strengthens the speaker icon so it remains easy to recognise.
Keeps the green circular button and existing speaking animation.

V1.5.27.title: Centred notification popup
features: Opens the bell notification panel in the middle of the screen.
Keeps the popup above the bottom navigation on phones and installed PWAs.
Adds a centred fade-and-scale animation and rounded modal layout.
Keeps backdrop tapping, close button and Escape-key closing behaviour.

V1.5.28.title: OTJMate and RemindMate
features: Added OTJMate with editable date, College/Workplace/Other hour presets, activity details, a 30-word learning reflection and optional photos.
OTJMate tracks recorded hours against 8 expected hours per elapsed week inside the course progress popup.
Each OTJ export contains the full details of new entries, stores the PDF locally and excludes exported entries from the next PDF.
Added RemindMate for review targets and dated tasks, including due-today and overdue notifications in the bell.

V1.5.29.title: Phone-style Toolbox app grid
features: Replaced the large Toolbox cards with rounded-square app icons in a four-column phone-style grid.
Sorted the mini apps alphabetically while keeping Settings permanently as the final app.
Added press feedback, white app symbols and app-theme-aware icon colours.
Added compact badges for saved NoteMate items, unexported OTJMate entries and due RemindMate reminders.

V1.5.30.title: Compact learner progress review
features: Rebuilt the learner-name progress popup as a compact, non-scrolling review dashboard.
Assignments, KSBs and OTJ now compare actual progress with the amount expected by today.
Restored EPA readiness using collective best EPA scores.
Added red-to-amber-to-green tracker bars and kept the popup above bottom navigation.
Moved learner profile editing into the Settings app.

V1.5.31.title: White Toolbox app icons
features: Changed every Toolbox and Settings app symbol to a high-contrast white icon.
Increased icon size slightly so each mini app is easier to recognise.
Prevented app-theme colours from overriding the white symbols.
Added a subtle icon shadow for visibility on lighter theme colours.

V1.5.33.title: Accurate NVQ learning-outcome progress
features: Counts repeated Learning Outcome numbers separately within each mandatory unit.
Includes Learning Outcomes from the learner’s selected optional unit in the total.
Moves the learner progress popup action from the learner name to the progress ring.
Displays time elapsed on a constant green line while retaining its current percentage marker.

V1.5.34.title: Current fitted tours and navigation-safe popups
features: Updates every i help tour to match the current Home, Course, Academy and eight-app Toolbox layouts.
Clarifies that the learner name is display-only and that progress opens from the progress ring.
Keeps help-tour controls fully above the bottom navigation on short phone screens.
Adds app-wide bottom-navigation clearance so popup, sheet and modal buttons remain visible and easy to press.

V1.5.35.title: Expanded notifications and compact OTJ exports
features: Adds notification controls for OTJMate, RemindMate, ProjectMate, progress reviews and Academy learning.
Removes photographs from OTJMate entries and exports.
Places multiple complete OTJ entries on each PDF page with thin green dividers.
Adds Copy entry to copy a complete Aptem-ready OTJ record to the phone clipboard.

V1.5.36.title: Restored stacked quick-tour layout
features: Restores the original mobile tour arrangement with the phone preview in the top half and guidance in the bottom half.
Keeps the complete tour above the fixed navigation bar on supported phone sizes.
Keeps Skip, Back, Next and Finish controls visible and easy to press.
Allows only the guidance paragraph to scroll when a smaller screen cannot display all text.

V1.5.32.title: White Icons on Green Surfaces
features: Changed silhouettes on every solid green action surface to white for clear contrast.
Applied the fix to primary buttons, active tabs, navigation, notification, speech, recording, reminder and Toolbox icons.
Protected white SVG strokes and filled icon shapes from being recoloured by the selected app theme.

V1.5.37.title: Storage and navigation recovery
features: Prevents a failed update backup from replacing the app with a false local-storage error.
Automatically removes older duplicate update backups before creating the current safety backup.
Keeps Toolbox, Course and Academy navigation responsive when an individual page encounters an error.
Separates genuine learner-data loading errors from optional backup, update and notification failures.
